section.content: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial detection and discloses an artificial intelligence-based machine learning system, which comprises a feature extraction module, a static model module and a characteristic analysis module, wherein the feature extraction module is used for preprocessing the same material with constant illumination and changed illumination, acquiring preprocessed image features and dividing the image features into constant illumination and variable illumination image features, and the static model module is used for carrying out association learning on the constant illumination image features based on a convolutional neural network, and specifically comprises the steps of carrying out convolution on all the constant illumination image features through a feature kernel C1 to obtain a feature map S1. According to the invention, the image characteristics of constant illumination and change of illumination are processed separately, the essential characteristics of constant illumination are learned by combining with the static model module, and the influence of the change of illumination is quantified by utilizing the dynamic model module. By constructing the illumination influence model, the real defects on the surface of the material and the illumination interference can be accurately distinguished, and the misjudgment rate in industrial detection is greatly reduced.

本发明涉及工业检测技术领域，且公开了基于人工智能的机器学习系统，包括：特征提取模块，对同一材料进行光照不变和光照改变的预处理，对预处理后的图像特征进行获取，并且将该图像特征划分为光照不变和光照改变的图像特征；静态模型模块，基于卷积神经网络来对光照不变的图像特征进行关联学习，其具体步骤有：将所有光照不变的图像特征通过特征核C1，对所述图像特征进行卷积来获得特征图S1。本发明通过分离处理光照不变和光照改变的图像特征，结合静态模型模块学习光照不变的本质特征，并利用动态模型模块量化光照变化的影响。通过构建光照影响模型，能精准区分材料表面真实缺陷与光照干扰，大幅降低工业检测中的误判率。

Machine learning system based on artificial intelligenceTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of industrial detection, in particular to a machine learning system based on artificial intelligence.

Background

In the fields of industrial detection and material surface analysis, the traditional method often causes unstable image characteristics due to the change of illumination conditions, and is difficult to distinguish real defects from illumination interference, so that the problems of high misjudgment rate and insufficient detection precision are caused. In addition, the traditional method relies on manual adjustment of a light source or a large amount of labeling data, has low efficiency and high cost, and restricts popularization and application effects of intelligent detection.

The prior patent discloses an artificial intelligence data analysis method and system (publication number CN 118428493B) based on machine learning, which relate to the technical field of data analysis and comprise the steps of collecting data in a data source, preprocessing the data, and extracting characteristics of the preprocessed data. Although the prior art attempts to alleviate the interference through a fixed light source or multi-angle shooting, the lack of systematic modeling of the illumination invariant features and the dynamic illumination influence leads to limited generalization capability of the model and difficulty in adapting to complex and changeable industrial scenes.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention provides a machine learning system based on artificial intelligence for solving the existing technical problems, and solves the problems of low efficiency and high cost due to the fact that a light source is manually adjusted or a large amount of labeling data is depended on.

To solve the above technical problem, according to one aspect of the present invention, more specifically, an artificial intelligence-based machine learning system includes:

the feature extraction module is used for preprocessing the same material with constant illumination and changed illumination, acquiring the preprocessed image features and dividing the image features into image features with constant illumination and changed illumination;

The static model module carries out association learning on the image characteristics with unchanged illumination based on a convolutional neural network, and comprises the following specific steps:

1) All the image features with unchanged illumination are convolved through a feature kernel C1 to obtain a feature map S1;

2) Sampling the region similar to the feature kernel C1 in the feature map S1 to obtain a sampling map A1;

3) Passing all the image features with unchanged illumination through the feature kernel C2 again and obtaining a feature map S2;

4) Sampling the region similar to the feature kernel C2 in the feature map S2 to obtain a sampling map A2;

the attention introducing module outputs unified embedded vectors according to cosine similarity in the sampling graph A1 and the sampling graph A2 in all the image characteristics with unchanged illumination;

The dynamic model module is used for processing the image characteristics of illumination change through the characteristic kernel C1 and the characteristic kernel C2 respectively to obtain vectors of the image characteristic sampling graph A1 and the image characteristic sampling graph A2 of the illumination change;

the model construction module is used for constructing an illumination influence model according to the relation between the embedded vector of the illumination-unchanged image characteristic and the vectors of the sampling graph A1 and the sampling graph A2 of the illumination-unchanged image characteristic;

And the illumination judging module is used for judging the condition of illumination change on the basis of the illumination influence model on other image characteristics of the same material.

Furthermore, the cross-modal alignment unit outputs a unified embedded vector by adopting a contrast loss function, and then the contrast loss function comprises:

In the formula, L represents characteristic features obtained after the same material is subjected to illumination invariant shooting, sim represents cosine similarity of a sampling graph A1 and a sampling graph A2 in illumination invariant image features, N represents the number of all illumination invariant image feature samples, and N represents the total number of all illumination invariant image features.

Further, the pretreatment of the illumination change comprises the following specific steps:

1) Disposing an acquisition camera at a vertical plane of the material, the acquisition camera for acquiring image features of the material;

2) Arranging a fixed light source at a 45-degree included angle of a plane of the material, and acquiring an image characteristic of unchanged illumination, which is acquired by a camera;

3) The circular motion light source is arranged at the 45-degree included angle of the plane of the material, and the image features acquired by the acquisition camera are the image features with changed illumination.

Further, the material is one of a plate, equipment and a device.

Furthermore, the convolution kernel of the static model module, which is convolved through the feature kernel C1 and the feature kernel C2, is the same as the feature of the convolution kernel of the dynamic model module, which is convolved through the feature kernel C1 and the feature kernel C2.

Further, the specific steps of the model construction module for constructing the illumination influence model are as follows:

1) Changing the position of the light source according to different angles of 0-180 degrees so as to obtain image features of different angles;

2) Sequencing the illumination influence degree of the image features according to the light sources with different angles;

3) Determining a relation characteristic x according to the influence degree of the light source and the relation between the sampled image A1 vector and the unified embedded vector in the image characteristics of different angles;

4) Determining a relation feature y according to the influence degree of the light source and the relation between the sampled image A2 vector and the unified embedded vector in the image features of different angles;

5) A lighting effect model is constructed based on the association between the relationship feature x and the relationship feature y.

Furthermore, the illumination influence model is constructed according to variable control of illumination invariance and illumination change, and whether illumination influence and intervention exist in the image graph is determined according to the deviation of the vectors of the sampling graph A1, the sampling graph A2 and the unified embedding vector which are acquired subsequently. Then the specific illumination influence model is:

Furthermore, the output result of the illumination judging module is displayed in real time through a visual interface, and the interface synchronously displays the original image, the analysis curve of the illumination influence model and the illumination intervention probability score.

Furthermore, the system integrates a migration learning mechanism, so that the weights of the feature kernel C1 and the feature kernel C2 of the pre-trained static model module are allowed to migrate to the corresponding convolution layer of the dynamic model module, thereby accelerating model convergence and improving cross-material generalization capability.

Compared with the prior art, the machine learning system based on artificial intelligence provided by the invention has the following effects:

1. According to the invention, the image characteristics of constant illumination and change of illumination are processed separately, the essential characteristics of constant illumination are learned by combining with the static model module, and the influence of the change of illumination is quantified by utilizing the dynamic model module. By constructing the illumination influence model, the real defects on the surface of the material and the illumination interference can be accurately distinguished, and the misjudgment rate in industrial detection is greatly reduced.

2. According to the invention, a model construction module is used for establishing a correlation model of the light source angles and the condition coefficients by analyzing the deviation of the sampling graph vectors and the unified embedding vectors under different light source angles. When an abnormality is detected, the illumination interference angle interval can be deduced reversely, and the site is guided to quickly adjust the position of the light source or compensate illumination.

3. The feature kernel C1/C2 weight pre-trained by the static model module can be directly transferred to the dynamic model module, so that repeated training is avoided. The unified embedded vector generated by combining the contrast loss function is used as a reference feature, the system can be quickly adapted to different materials, the deployment period of a new scene is obviously shortened, and the generalization of the model is enhanced.
